props.description: An animated diagram: the seaborn label on the left emits a glowing beam labeled 'sns.barplot(...)' that flows through a funnel and exits as a matplotlib Axes rectangle on the right. The Axes object then slides into position in a 2x2 subplot grid like a puzzle piece snapping in. Three more seaborn calls animate in sequence, each filling a subplot cell. The final frame shows all four cells filled and labeled — making the data-flow relationship between the two libraries conceptually clear and satisfying.
